summary: Iteration 4 — Frontend-only verification of favicon/SEO, /reserver reactivation, CeTEST test products (restaurant + épicerie), admin CeTEST-0001 order card actions, and full E2E order flow menu→cart→checkout→tracking. All primary flows pass. Only issue: the seeded reservation R-CeTEST-01 renders with EMPTY customer_name, phone, email and party_size in the admin Réservations tab (date/time '2026-07-20 · 19:30' + status NEW are correct). One environment note: the SEO/OG/JSON-LD tags in /app/frontend/public/index.html were NOT initially reflected in the dev-server response — a supervisor `frontend restart` was required to pick them up. After restart, curl confirms all favicon/OG/twitter/geo/JSON-LD tags are served correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Seeded reservation R-CeTEST-01 displays as: 'NEW 2026-07-20 · 19:30 / · · / Personnes :' — the customer name, phone, email and party_size are all blank. The reservation is correctly listed by date/time but the render shows empty separators. Root cause is likely one of: (a) the seed inserted the doc with keys that don't match Reservation model (e.g. 'name' vs 'customer_name', 'guests' vs 'party_size'), or (b) admin list endpoint /api/admin/reservations returns those fields as null for this record. All other reservations in the list (TEST_Alice, TESTPW_Alice) render fully.

issues: Leftover 'TEST_Product' (CHF 12.50) from previous iteration still visible in Antipasti on both public /commander and admin Menu tab. Should be cleaned up from the seeded DB.

action_items: Investigate why the seeded reservation R-CeTEST-01 has empty customer_name / phone / email / party_size in the admin listing. Verify the MongoDB doc actually contains name='CeTEST Test', phone, email, party_size=2 with the correct keys matched by the ReservationOut Pydantic model. Re-seed or PATCH the doc to fix.
Delete leftover 'TEST_Product' from Antipasti (previous iteration seed). Not blocking but pollutes public menu.

IMPORTANT: index.html changes in a CRA dev server require a webpack/dev-server restart to be picked up. Because the deployment relies on `craco start` (via supervisor), any change to /app/frontend/public/index.html should trigger `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`. Consider documenting this or moving SEO tags to react-helmet-async so they hot-reload.
critical_code_review_comments: SEO/OG/favicon/JSON-LD in /app/frontend/public/index.html look correct and complete: og:type=restaurant.restaurant, og:image + favicon → Angelucci's logo, twitter:card summary_large_image, geo.region=CH-VD, address 'Av. William-Fraisse 1' with postalCode 1006 Lausanne inside a Restaurant + Store JSON-LD @graph. Description mentions Lausanne, restaurant italien, épicerie. Solid schema.org coverage.

OrderModePicker exposes proper data-testids (slot-asap, today-time-*, time-*) that make automation easy.
Checkout page exposes checkout-first-name / checkout-last-name / checkout-phone / checkout-email / checkout-promo / change-time-btn / submit-order-btn — all reachable programmatically. Great DX.

OrderTracking page (/suivi/{id}) content after a successful submit appears to render the /commander Menu component (title 'Il Ristorante', 'Aucun produit disponible', category list). Please verify the actual UX at /suivi/{id} is intended to look like a Menu-shell — it may be confusing to the customer expecting an order-status screen. Possibly a route mismatch or the tracking page reuses Menu layout without content.
Admin Réservations rendering: the card layout gracefully leaves blank slots for missing fields (no crash) but this masks bad seed data. Consider defaulting to '—' or 'Sans nom' so operators notice.

Cart persistence bug from iteration_3 (localStorage race in CartContext) — did NOT reproduce this run because I opened cart via the sticky bar (SPA navigation preserves state). Not re-verified with a hard reload; still applies per iteration_3 notes.

rca of the issue: R-CeTEST-01 empty fields RCA: the admin Réservations tab rendered card is missing customer_name, phone, email, party_size while another seeded doc (TESTPW_Alice, TEST_Alice) renders them fully. The rendering logic is uniform, so this is a data-shape issue with THIS record only. Likely mismatch between the seed script keys (e.g. `name`, `guests`) and the Pydantic Reservation model / MongoDB stored keys (e.g. `customer_name`, `party_size`). Mitigation: (a) fetch GET /api/admin/reservations, find id R-CeTEST-01, inspect the returned JSON keys; (b) either update seed doc via mongosh with correct keys or PATCH via admin API; (c) add a defensive display fallback ('—') so blank data is visible to operators.
